description: Defines data structures and interfaces related to reporting endpoints and endpoint groups in the net namespace, including classes for identifying, configuring, and managing reporting endpoints and their associated metadata.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey
classes.description: Identifies a unique group of reporting endpoints based on network, origin, reporting source, and group name.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a reporting endpoint with configuration details, statistics, and validation status.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint::EndpointInfo
classes.description: Contains URL, priority, and weight information for a reporting endpoint.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint::Statistics
classes.description: Tracks upload attempts and successes for reporting endpoints.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: Defines a set of reporting endpoints associated with an origin, including subdomain inclusion and TTL.

classes.name: CachedReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: In-memory or persistent storage representation of a reporting endpoint group, including expiration and last used timestamps.

methods.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey(const NetworkAnonymizationKey&, const url::Origin&, const std::string&)
methods.description: Constructs a group key with specified network, origin, and group name.

methods.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey(const NetworkAnonymizationKey&, absl::optional<base::UnguessableToken>, const url::Origin&, const std::string&)
methods.description: Constructs a group key with an optional reporting source.

methods.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey(const ReportingEndpointGroupKey&, const absl::optional<base::UnguessableToken>&)
methods.description: Copy constructor with optional reporting source.

methods.name: ReportingEndpoint(const ReportingEndpointGroupKey&, const EndpointInfo&)
methods.description: Constructs a reporting endpoint with specified group key and info.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the reporting endpoint is valid.

methods.name: operator bool()
methods.description: Converts ReportingEndpoint to boolean based on validity.

methods.name: CachedReportingEndpointGroup(const ReportingEndpointGroupKey&, OriginSubdomains, base::Time, base::Time)
methods.description: Constructs a cached endpoint group with explicit parameters.

methods.name: CachedReportingEndpointGroup(const ReportingEndpointGroup&, base::Time)
methods.description: Constructs a cached endpoint group from a runtime group and current time.
